contact_edits.before: Part of Gilbert's purpose seems to be to blame gay authors of musicals, especially successful ones, for not dealing with gay subjects. He also has a go at fellow playwrights, taking potshots at Brad Fraser for depicting just such a lifestyle as he himself seems to be advocating. No, wait, that's in the play-within-the-play -- the hypocritical one -- so maybe it doesn't count. Either way, a piece as flimsy as this is hardly a solid foundation from which to attack other writers. In this show -- it isn't true of all his plays -- Gilbert doesn't seem to like anyone very much, including his own characters. As Bertolt Brecht so very nearly said, Happy is the show that needs no heroes. - Happy: A Very Gay Little Musical runs at the Buddies in Bad Times Theatre, 12 Alexander St., until April 27, 2008. Call 416-975-8555 for more information.
